result.summary: The home feed renders cleanly overall, but the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab. A minor inconsistency also appears in the favorite-button styling between cards.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab in green, but the screen shown is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, search, categories, promotions, restaurant lists). The 'Home' tab is shown in the inactive grey state. Users get conflicting location cues, and tapping Home may seem to do nothing.
issues.suggestion: Sync the bottom-nav selected state with the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on this screen and 'Profile' is shown as inactive.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart has almost no visible backdrop against the dark image. On the pizza card below, it sits on a clearly visible dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-opaque circular backdrop to all card favorite buttons so they look consistent and stay legible on any image.
